anomalies.observed: In the WATER LEVEL SENSOR/SWITCHES block the TF-Luna LiDAR (PR9) is connected through header H7 (PB_1.25mm) onto the main I2C bus: its SDA/SCL pins land on NET0062/NET0079 and its VCC on +5V. No HC-SR04-style ultrasonic sensor or trigger/echo GPIO nets appear anywhere in the schematic; the only 'Water Height Sensor' drawn is the LiDAR.
anomalies.expected: Per the spec the LiDAR is documentation-only and must not be wired: 'all four pins (VCC, SDA, SCL, GND) typed free — i.e., it is not connected to any net in this design' (§4.3). The water-level sensor that is 'actually wired and actually used by firmware is an HC-SR04-style ultrasonic sensor read on two ESP32 GPIOs' (§4.4).

evidence.quote: the r2 netlist shows PR1 ... all four pins (VCC, SDA, SCL, GND) typed free — i.e., it is not connected to any net in this design (§4.3)
the water-level sensing that is actually wired and actually used by firmware is an HC-SR04-style ultrasonic sensor read on two ESP32 GPIOs (§4.4)
Sheet 1, WATER LEVEL SENSOR/SWITCHES: PR9 LiDAR -> H7 -> NET0062 / NET0079 / +5V; no ultrasonic symbol present

anomalies.impact: Automatic top-off level measurement as the firmware expects (ultrasonic on two GPIOs) has no hardware on this board, so ATO water-level sensing would not function as intended; meanwhile an unmanaged LiDAR device is placed on the shared I2C bus.

anomalies.observed: The ATO solenoid-valve low-side switch is drawn as T2 = A03400A (SOT-23, 30 V N-MOSFET).
anomalies.expected: The spec's component table assigns the ATO valve switch to an AON6407 (8-DFN N-MOSFET): 'T3 — AON6407 (8-DFN N-MOSFET) ATO solenoid-valve low-side switch'. A 30 V SOT-23 part on a 24 V inductive load has only marginal Vds headroom versus the intended higher-rated DFN device.

evidence.quote: T3 — AON6407 (8-DFN N-MOSFET) | ATO solenoid-valve low-side switch
Sheet 1/3, ATO Valve: T2 A03400A driven via R15/NET0083 and level-shifter T8

anomalies.impact: If AON6407 was selected for its higher voltage/current rating, substituting a 30 V SOT-23 AO3400A reduces margin on the 24 V inductive valve load, risking avalanche/stress on flyback transients.

parsed.summary: The power train, isolators (pH/EC isolated, RTD unisolated), three TMC2209 dosing drivers with 110 m sense and shared UART, float interlocks, TVS/fuse and buck/LDO values all match the spec. The main deviation is the water-level sensing: the schematic wires the TF-Luna LiDAR (PR9/H7) onto the I2C bus and omits the HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor that the spec states is the actually-wired and firmware-used level sensor, which would break ATO level sensing; a secondary, lower-confidence concern is the ATO valve MOSFET being an A03400A instead of the specified AON6407.
